svg.font-family: 'STIX Two Text','STIX Two Math','Times New Roman',serif
svg.title: Empirical marginal interval coverage
svg.desc: Computed coverage table: rows are the 26 parameters, columns the nominal 50, 80, 90 and 95% central intervals. Each cell prints the empirical coverage in percent; colors show empirical minus nominal coverage in percentage points, clipped at plus or minus 25.
